import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return

    points = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(5):
            points[i][j] = int(next(it))

    class Vec:
        __slots__ = ('a','b','c','d','e')
        def __init__(self, a, b, c, d, e):
            self.a = a
            self.b = b
            self.c = c
            self.d = d
            self.e = e
        def dot(self, o):
            return self.a * o.a + self.b * o.b + self.c * o.c + self.d * o.d + self.e * o.e
        def __eq__(self, other):
            if not isinstance(other, Vec):
                return False
            return (self.a == other.a and self.b == other.b and self.c == other.c and
                    self.d == other.d and self.e == other.e)
        def __hash__(self):
            return hash((self.a, self.b, self.c, self.d, self.e))

    bad = [False] * n

    for i in range(n):
        vectors = set()
        for j in range(n):
            vectors.add(Vec(
                points[j][0] - points[i][0],
                points[j][1] - points[i][1],
                points[j][2] - points[i][2],
                points[j][3] - points[i][3],
                points[j][4] - points[i][4]
            ))
        unique = list(vectors)
        found = False
        for a in range(len(unique)):
            if found:
                break
            for b in range(a+1, len(unique)):
                if unique[a].dot(unique[b]) > 0:
                    found = True
                    break
        bad[i] = found

    good = sum(1 for b in bad if not b)
    print(good)
    for i, b in enumerate(bad):
        if not b:
            print(i+1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
